comment: Blood Sun step 6c, MTG_BLOODSUN_USER_PRUNE OFF (the unrestricted twin): pre-Blood Sun with one other land out neither Lotus is played (USER: "neither of these should ever be played when there is no Blood Sun and 1 or 0 lands out"). The autonomous main-phase menu on the board as authored, counted by summary substring "Lotus". Lever OFF the option does NOT return here: the engine's own step-2 folds already keep both Lotuses off this menu (fold V1: a Vale with fewer than two untapped lands to sacrifice; a Field with one other land), so the USER rule is redundant on this board -- pinned so a change to those folds shows.
